_meta.description: Observed market price bands (INR) for handmade goods, hand-curated from public ONDC / Amazon Karigar / Etsy 'handmade in India' listings. Used to ground the AI's fair-price estimate against what comparable items actually sell for. sample_count is the honest number of listings we eyeballed per category, not a scraped dataset.
_meta.provisional_note: Categories with sample_count 0 are provisional estimates, not sampled data. They exist so an unmatched craft is not priced off the generic default; they should be replaced with observed listings before submission.
